**Claude:** Redesign done and committed (`7978c16`). The emulator on your desktop is running the new build with a few seeded test tasks and habits — try it.

What changed, concretely — the previous version was default Material widgets wearing a theme; this one has an actual design language, borrowed from Things 3:

- **Typography**: Inter is bundled (display cut for the big titles, text cuts elsewhere) with a tightened custom type scale — same face as the original woooosh web app.
- **Color**: dropped Android's dynamic color (that's where the drab gray-blue came from) for a crafted indigo scheme with a properly tuned near-black dark theme. Status colors are muted fills with saturated dots.
- **Structure**: every screen leads with a small indigo eyebrow line ("4 OPEN", "1 OF 2 TODAY", the date) over a big display title.
- **Components**: borderless cards on a soft shadow, quiet neutral checkboxes that fill indigo, custom filter pills (selected = ink-dark), a borderless composer field with tinted status pills, circular FAB, restyled nav bar, and designed empty states instead of a floating string.

The APK at `android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk` is this build — copy it to your phone whenever you're happy (it'll start clean; the test data lives only on the emulator). If the design still isn't hitting the bar for you anywhere specific, point at the screen and I'll iterate on it.
